security_boundaries: production guard failure blocks automatic replan
manual replan bypasses storm guard but still uses tenant context
tenant_boundaries: DB storm state filters scheduling runs by primaryOrgId
run mutation now uses composite org+runId ownership
failure_paths: guard failure is suppressed/debounced or production fail-closed
plan persistence failures roll back atomically and mark run failed
unknown objective missing does not fabricate suppression

findings.evidence: Five scheduling-run status mutations used runId alone although database uniqueness is (orgId, runId).
findings.impact: A cross-tenant run with the same runId could be marked succeeded/failed, corrupting another organization’s run memory.
findings.fix: Constrain every run status mutation by authenticated primaryOrgId plus runId and rerun replan guard, storm, stability and dual-instance tests.

findings.evidence: Missing primaryOrgId collapses to ALL for guard key and GUC settings.
findings.impact: Internal callers without tenant context share a guard namespace; production HTTP paths require authenticated org.
findings.fix: Keep internal-system boundary explicit or fail closed when opening this API beyond trusted callers.
